title: selinum gmelinii
intro: Selinum gmelinii, commonly known as Russian angelica, is a plant species native to Russia and China. It is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting the immune system. The plant has therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes, phenolic acids, and essential oils. These bioactive constituents contribute to the plant's ability to protect against oxidative stress, promote wound healing, and exhibit antiviral and antibacterial activities.
